en: \bMorty: \PN, the one chosen by Ho-oh. Come at me with everything you've got!
\bMorty: As expected of the one chosen by Ho-oh.
\bMorty: Guess I'm worthy of meeting Ho-oh now.
\bChuck: Hahaha! Good to see you, \PN. You'd better give it your all!
\bChuck: Hoo... Back to training.
\bChuck: Hahaha! You'd better get back to training!
\rJasmine: Glad we don't have to wait so long for a battle this time, \PN. Get ready, my steel types will hang on until the end!
\rJasmine: Come and visit me and Amphy any time!
\rJasmine: See, we lasted until the end.
\bPryce: \PN, thank you again for reminding me the importance of bonds and trust with my Pokémon. But I won't hold back against you because of that!
\bPryce: Haha, looks like you still cherish your Pokémon deeply.
\bPryce: Our bonds and trust were what brought us this victory.
\rClair: I use my full power against any opponent. Especially you, \PN!
\rClair: My full power... wasn't enough?
\rClair: Well, don't underestimate me next time.
\bKoga: \PN, I can tell that you've learnt that brute strength isn't everything. So I'm gonna make you feel the despair of poison and my ninja techniques!
\bKoga: This despair... I've never felt it before. I'll need to hone my ninja senses even more for next time.
\bKoga: Continue to practice and hone your skills.
\bBruno: Ready to battle, \PN? Hoo hah!
\bBruno: Time for some intense training!
\bBruno: Time for you to do some intense training!
\rLyra: Hey \PN, long time no see! I've grown so much stronger since the last time we met. Wanna find out how much?
\rLyra: You've grown so much stronger too!
\rLyra: My training paid off!
\bEthan: Let me know if you ever want help, OK?
\bEthan: We've got your back.
\bEthan: See you around!
\bElm: Hey \PN, how's it going? I hope I can give you a good battle.
\bElm: Oh? Well, I suppose I should've expected that.
\bElm: Try not to overdo it.
\rRoxanne: Hey \PN! The kids at my school are really looking up to you now. Let's show them a battle where strategy shines!
\rRoxanne: Your strategies caught me off guard!
\rRoxanne: My strategies were executed flawlessly.
\bBrawly: Oh, \PN! You'd better be prepared, my Pokémon have been trained harder than ever against the waves!
\bBrawly: Looks like we couldn't overcome this huge wave this time.
\bBrawly: Just another big wave that my Pokémon were able to overcome.
\bWattson: Wahaha! I'm looking forward to an electrifying battle, \PN!
\bWattson: Wahaha! You made sparks fly out of me!
\bWattson: Wahaha! Looks like sparks flew out of you!
\rFlannery: Welcome to... wait, this isn't my gym. Ah whatever, you know how this works. Let's just battle!
\rFlannery: I overheated from your fiery passion!
\rFlannery: Told you I wasn't easy!
\bNorman: Hello again, PN. Thank you again for taking care of Max and May during your time in Hoenn. As thanks, let me show you my newly honed skills.
\bNorman: That's what I'd expect from a Champion! But be sure to grow even stronger for our next battle.
\bNorman: I look forward to battling you again, \PN.
\rWinona: \PN, witness our elegant choreography!
\rWinona: Keep soaring high, \PN.
\rWinona: I was one with my bird Pokémon and it showed!
\bTate: Surprised to see both of us here together, \PN? \rLiza: After all, we battle as one with our awesome, powerful combination!
\bTate: Our teamwork failed! \rLiza: We'll improve our combination even more!
\bTate: Our teamwork worked! \rLiza: Don't underestimate our combination!
\bJuan: \PN! Bear witness to our improved artistry.
\bJuan: You won beautifully.
\bJuan: What a beautiful win!
\bDrake: Well \PN! Dealt with that cockiness of yours now, have you? Show it to me in battle!
\bDrake: Very good! Keep pressing forward!
\bDrake: Don't think my age has slowed me down!
\rMay: Hey \PN! Let me show you what my contest experience in Johto has taught me!
\rMay: Haha, you're still as strong as ever!
\rMay: Is it time to challenge the Grand Festival again?
\bBirch: Didn't imagine seeing me here, \PN? Sure, I might not be at your level, but I can put up a fight.
\bBirch: Alright, we'll get the hang of this next time.
\bBirch: I did better than I expected!
\bRoark: Hey \PN. Looks like it'll be my strength that gets tested this time!
\bRoark: I wonder if my father will be a match for you now.
\bRoark: I smash my way through any obstacle.
\rGardenia: You still have that winning aura around you, \PN. Let's see if you'll win again!
\rGardenia: You're still pretty good, huh?
\rGardenia: Looks like I caught you off-guard!
\rMaylene: I accept your challenge, \PN! I already know that you'll be super hard to beat.
\rMaylene: Ha... ha... You're tough. But I'm gonna keep getting stronger, just you wait!
\rMaylene: Ha... ha... You're tough. But I trained so hard for this moment and it paid off!
\bCrasher Wake: \PN! My Pokémon will take everything you can throw at them and pull you under!
\bCrasher Wake: I got pulled under instead!
\bCrasher Wake: Come back when you resurface from that!
\rFantina: Ohohoho! You wish to see me dance, yes? Very well, let us dance, \PN.
\rFantina: It seems that even a single misstep can be fatal. Very well, I will keep refining my dance!
\rFantina: Ohohoho! You'll need to do better than that to stop the dance of my Ghost type Pokémon!
\bByron: Oh, \PN! Remember, I'm not as weak as my son!
\bByron: Looks like you completely broke through our defense!
